Color Spray (W1 Illu): 15' cone renders creatures with 2/4/5+ HD unconscious for 2d4 rd/blind for 1d4 rd/stunned for 1 rd (save Will negates)

Gaseous Form (W3 Tran): Touched becomes insubstantial, losing its armor bonus to Armor Class, any supernatural abilities, ability to manipulate objects, and ability to cast spells with components, but gaining DR 10/magic, immunity to poison and critical hits, a 10' fly Speed, and the ability to pass through small openings, for 16 min
Ghoul Touch (W2 Necr): Melee touch inflicts paralyzed and a stench that sickens creatures other than self (save Fortitude negates) in a 10' radius for 1d6+2 rd

Grease (W1 Conj): R45' Coats a 10' square with grease, inflicting falls (save Reflex negates and allows a DC 10 Balance check to move at half speed), or coats a target object with grease (save Reflex negates for possessed items), causing them to be dropped (save Reflex negates each rd), for 8 rd
Hold Portal (W1 Abju): R180' Holds shut a door, gate, or window, adding +5 to the DC to force it, for 8 min

Magic Weapon (W1 Tran): Touched weapon gains +1 attacks and damage for 8 min
Nystul's Magic Aura (W1 Illu): Alters the magical aura of an object weighing up to 40 lb for 8 days
Prestidigitation (W0 Univ): R10' Allows performing minor magic effects for 1 hr
Protection From Energy (W3 Abju): Touched gains immunity to a choice of acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic for 80 min or until 96 HP have been negated
Protection From Evil (W1 Abju): Gives touched a +2 deflection bonus to Armor Class and +2 saves vs. evil creatures, suppresses mental control, prevents possession, and bars contact by nongood summoned creatures for 8 min
Read Magic (W0 Divi): Allows self to read magical writing for 80 min
Reduce Person (W1 Tran): R45' Target humanoid becomes half size (save Fortitude negates), suffering -2 Strength and gaining +2 Dexterity, +1 attack, and a +1 size bonus to Armor Class, for 8 min
Remove Curse (W4 Abju): Dispels all curses from touched

Pernicious Magic: Weave casters require successful DC 19 caster level check to counter self spells other than evocation and transmutation; self requires successful DC 9 + casterLevel caster level check to counter Weave spells other than enchantment, illusion, and necromancy
Persistent Spell: May use +4 spell slot to extend duration of a personal or ranged spell to 1 dy
Quicken Spell: Once per rd, can cast a spell with a casting time of up to 1 rd as a free action, using a spell slot 4 levels higher than normal
Scribe Scroll: Can create scrolls for known spells
Shadow Weave Magic: +1 DC and resistance checks on enchantment, illusion, necromancy, and darkness descriptor spells/-1 caster level on evocation and transmutation spells/May not cast light descriptor spells
Signature Spell: May cast chosen mastered spell in place of prepared arcane spell
Silent Spell: Can cast a spell using a spell slot 1 level higher than normal to cast it without verbal components
Spell Mastery: Can prepare 1 chosen spell without using a spellbook
Spell Penetration: +2 checks to overcome spell resistance
Still Spell: Can cast a spell using a spell slot 1 level higher than normal to cast it without somatic components
Tenacious Magic: Weave casters require successful DC 23 caster level check to dispel self spells other than evocation and transmutation; self requires successful DC 13 + casterLevel caster level check to dispel Weave spells other than enchantment, illusion, and necromancy
